benchmark: Economic OS Loss-Aware Standards Interoperability Adversarial Corpus

source_snapshot.iso20022_catalogue_snapshot: Catalogue page last updated 2026-03-19 for selected payment/cash-management sets
source_snapshot.caveat: Version/effective-date applicability must be selected by the actual jurisdiction and transaction scope; this corpus is synthetic.

cases.stimulus: An Intent node is imported and incorrectly counted as delivered resource.
cases.required_control: Intent remains a plan; no delivery effect is inferred.

cases.stimulus: A commitment is fulfilled only partially by one EconomicEvent.
cases.required_control: Preserve fulfilled and remaining quantities separately.

cases.stimulus: A kilogram event is mapped to a litre resource without a qualified conversion.
cases.required_control: Reject or hold; no raw numeric unit substitution.

cases.stimulus: A later correction mutates the original EconomicEvent payload.
cases.required_control: Append a correction/compensating lineage record.

cases.threat: Foreign IDs collide with local IDs
cases.stimulus: A remote resource identifier equals a local ID string but uses a different namespace.
cases.required_control: Namespace-qualified IDs remain distinct.

cases.stimulus: A PDF receipt is imported without source activity or capture provenance.
cases.required_control: Preserve artifact bytes but mark source provenance incomplete.

cases.stimulus: A PROV association names a user but no scoped credential or mandate exists.
cases.required_control: Provenance responsibility does not authorize a value mutation.

cases.stimulus: A normalized bank record is produced without binding its source message digest.
cases.required_control: No independent evidence claim without source-to-transform lineage.

cases.stimulus: Two bundles assert incompatible source derivations for the same evidence entity.
cases.required_control: Preserve both lineages and block stronger claim projection.

cases.threat: Receiving event treated as title transfer
cases.stimulus: An ObjectEvent reports receiving at a site but has no ownership evidence.
cases.required_control: Visibility is not title/ownership.

cases.threat: Event time differs from record time
cases.stimulus: An event is captured late and arrives after a later event.
cases.required_control: Preserve eventTime and recordTime separately; do not use arrival order as truth.

cases.threat: Shipment event treated as beneficiary acceptance
cases.stimulus: A shipping/dispatch event exists but the beneficiary has not accepted delivery.
cases.required_control: Delivery/acceptance profile remains pending.

cases.threat: Duplicate capture of same event ID
cases.stimulus: The same signed/identified visibility event is delivered more than once.
cases.required_control: Duplicate evidence does not multiply resource movement.

cases.stimulus: A payment initiation message has been transmitted but no later status/settlement evidence exists.
cases.required_control: Instruction is not settlement.

cases.threat: pacs.002 accepted status promoted to finality
cases.stimulus: A status report indicates accepted for processing under a specific scheme.
cases.required_control: Interpret exact status using scheme/version-specific finality semantics.

cases.stimulus: A payment return message arrives after an original transfer.
cases.required_control: Keep original and append linked return/compensation.

cases.stimulus: An intraday report, statement and debit/credit notification describe the same bank transaction.
cases.required_control: Use stable bank transaction identity and report scope.

cases.threat: Syntax valid but country rule fails
cases.stimulus: An invoice passes XML syntax/EN 16931 but fails a country-qualified rule.
cases.required_control: Keep stage results distinct; do not call the invoice profile-conformant.

cases.stimulus: An adapter validates against BIS 3.0.20 after 3.0.21 became mandatory for the relevant scope/date.
cases.required_control: Pin exact BIS release, effective date and country pack.

cases.threat: Valid invoice treated as proof of receipt/payment
cases.stimulus: A Peppol-valid invoice has no independent delivery or bank evidence.
cases.required_control: Invoice validity is not receipt or settlement.

cases.threat: FX rate treated as unit conversion
cases.stimulus: USD valuation is converted to ZAR using a current FX rate but no rate observation/profile is bound.
cases.required_control: FX is a separate valuation/exchange event, not unit scale conversion.

cases.stimulus: An adapter loses issuer/network, unit scale, event time or original source reference on export.
cases.required_control: Round-trip required fields or return an explicit lossy/unsupported result.

cases.threat: Same operation represented by multiple standards
cases.stimulus: Valueflows Commitment, ISO instruction and EPCIS event refer to one obligation but have different canonical IDs.
cases.required_control: Bind standard identifiers as evidence/causal references under one stable operation identity.

cases.stimulus: The same immutable events arrive in different transport orders.
cases.required_control: Canonical projection is identical for the same evidence set and temporal frontier.

metrics.name: False payment finality
metrics.target: 0 instructions/status-only observations promoted to final settlement

metrics.name: False physical acceptance/title
metrics.target: 0 visibility events promoted to acceptance or title without qualified evidence

metrics.name: Duplicate observation effect multiplication
metrics.target: 0 additional effects from duplicate evidence IDs

metrics.name: Temporal replay reproducibility
metrics.target: 100% byte-identical output for frozen evidence and event/record-time frontiers

metrics.name: Round-trip semantic preservation
metrics.target: 100% required semantics preserved or explicitly flagged lossy/unsupported

metrics.name: Mapping/projection p50 p95 p99 latency
metrics.target: Measure by records, mappings and evidence refs; matched baseline required

metrics.name: Human review burden
metrics.target: Measure reviewer minutes per 100 ambiguous cases
